title: SIDScope required local delivery gates
policy: A delivery summary is ready only when every gate in this catalog has a valid same-source receipt; missing, duplicated, unknown, failed, not-run or unapproved-skipped gates block. Each receipt gate is bound to the frozen invocation below: the runner executes exactly that command and validators reject any other argv. The catalog is frozen: changing it is a delivery-policy change and requires a new format revision.

gates.description: Full CPU pytest suite on the clean candidate with zero failures and every skip reasoned.
gates.skip_policy: Skips are approved by identity, never by count: the recorded JUnit skip set must equal this approved list (nodeid exact, reason substring); any unknown, missing, replaced or unreasoned skip is unapproved. The runner writes the JUnit record into the gate evidence directory via PYTEST_ADDOPTS, keeping the executed argv identical to this invocation.
